text: The voice announcing the caller tune would be yours
Different caller tunes for different people - love songs for spouses/partners, bhagwan ke bhajan for parents

Okay.. maybe I’ll just reveal.. you are all near by They put Bollywood stars and cricketers on hoardings, with nothing but a phone number + “Call me.” When people dialed the number, they heard a song playing before the call connected. Then the celeb’s voice would say something like ”Hi! THis is Bipasha… did you like my song? Well, make it yours then! Press 1 to set it as yours?"... You would go from "product awareness > education > conversion + longterm retention (as most would forget it was even set and would keep paying Rs 15 every month)" in ONE ACTION. It was genius and made India’s caller tune market one of the world’s largest; this is confirmed in telecom industry reports and media analyses from the era.
apparently, her and Riya Sen were the top converters…followed by Sachin and Big B (this is anecdotal info from an ad exec I was speaking to)
